# ui::Notifier

Header: `winui/ui/Notification.hpp`.

What shows the notifications [ui::notify()](namespace-ui.md#notify) asks for.

There is one for the whole process: the platform's, or a double a test installs with [`ui::testing::set_notifier()`](../testing/namespace-ui-testing.md#set_notifier). App code calls [ui::notify()](namespace-ui.md#notify) and never needs the class. It is public so a test double can derive from it.

## ~Notifier

```cpp
virtual ~Notifier() = default
```

## notify

```cpp
virtual void notify(Notification notification) = 0
```

Shows `notification`.
